answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 54450 Country: United Kingdom Title: Toothpaste whilst fasting Question: Can one use toothpaste whilst fasting? Answer ID: 54450 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1199/1199/M=09/1435) It is makrooh to use toothpaste whilst fasting. One should avoid it. Though it does not nullify the fast but it decreases the reward. وكره له ذوق شئى وكذا مضغه الخ (درمختار) If the particles of the toothpaste will enter into throat then fast shall be invalid. (L) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
